premises.text: Building a scalable distributed backend today requires stitching many stores (relational, document, blob, search) and then wrestling sharding, sync, and replication at scale
premises.evidence_span: building that today, even today, is really hard. You have to combine a lot of different technologies

premises.text: Crate is an elastic distributed SQL data store that is simple to install/run/program, self-heals missing nodes while staying available, and supports fast real-time queries
premises.evidence_span: It gives you real-time SQL in a distributed environment

premises.text: Open-source core with paid enterprise licenses
premises.evidence_span: We're an open-source software, and on top, we sell enterprise licenses

value.text: Developers get scalable, reliable SQL backends that scale with application success without the usual distributed-systems pain
value.evidence_span: bring distributed SQL backends in the hand of every developer

causal_links.evidence_span: Scaling turns out to be more difficult than you thought
It gives you everything that you need to run a scalable backend
Create is available for download now

notes: Multi-store stitching and scale/shard/replication pains folded as one backend problem (§4.1.6). Docker/cloud/on-prem install, self-healing, and query speed folded as one Crate mechanism plus performance package (§4.1.7–8). IoT/telco/ads use cases treated as applications of the same store (§4.1.2). Founder prior-company credentials excluded. Anti-template: problem, product, and licensing separately revisable.
